3
Awurade ba no ho bɔhyɛ
1 # 2 Pe 1.13 Adɔfo, yei ne nwoma a ɛtɔ so mmienu a meretwerɛ mabrɛ mo. Emu na mede nkaeɛ mekanyane mo adwene gyenegyene, 2sɛ monkae nsɛm a adiyifoɔ kronkron no aka ato hɔ, ne yɛn a yɛyɛ mo asomafoɔ ahyɛdeɛ a ɛyɛ yɛn Awurade ne Agyenkwa deɛ no.
3 # 1 Ti 4.1 Monhunu yei kane sɛ, nna a ɛdi akyire no mu, fɛdifoɔ a wɔdi wɔn ara wɔn akɔnnɔ akyire de fɛdie bɛba 4#Yes 5.19; Hes 12.22; Mat 24.48 abɛka sɛ: Ne ba ho bɔhyɛ no wɔ he? Na ɛfirii sɛ agyanom dedaeɛ yi, ade nyinaa te sɛdeɛ ɛte firi adebɔ mfitiaseɛ. 5#Mat 24.38; Gye 1.2; 1.6; 1.9; Dwom 24.2 Na wɔhyɛ da ara ma wɔn werɛ firi sɛ, ɛfiri teteete na ɔsoro wɔ hɔ, ne asase a ɛfiri nsuo mu, na ɛfiri nsuo mfimfini na ɛbɛtimm hɔ wɔ Onyankopɔn asɛm so. 6#2 Pe 2.5; Gye 7.21 Wɔn so ara na ɛnam na nsuo yiri sɛee wiase a na ɛwɔ hɔ wɔn berɛ so no. 7#2 Pe 3.10 Na ɔsoro ne asase a ɛwɔ hɔ yi, wɔde n’asɛm no ara na akora, na wɔde asie ama ogya, ama atemmuo ne nnipa amumuyɛfoɔ sɛeɛ da no.
8 # Dwom 90.4 Na, adɔfo, mommma adeɛ baako yi nnhunta mo, sɛ da koro yɛ Awurade sɛ mfirinhyia apem, na mfirinhyia apem yɛ no sɛ da koro. 9#Hab 2.3; 1 Ti 2.4 Awurade nkyɛre ne bɔhyɛ ho, sɛdeɛ ebinom bu no sɛ ɛkyɛreɛ, na mmom ɔma ne bo dwo kyɛre ma mo, ɔmpɛ sɛ obiara bɛyera, na mmom ɔpɛ sɛ wɔn nyinaa ba adwensakyera mu. 10#1 Te 5.2-3; 2 Pe 3.7; Mat 24.29; 24.35; Adi 20.11 Na Awurade da no bɛba sɛdeɛ owifoɔ ba. Emu na ɔsoro de kukurududu bɛtwam akorɔ, na ewie mu mfitiasedeɛ bɛhye asɛe, na asase ne mu nnwuma bɛhye.
11Enti sɛ yeinom nyinaa bɛsɛe a, nnipa bɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ moyɛ wɔ abrabɔ kronkron ne nyamesom pa mu, 12sɛ motwɛn na morepɛ Nyankopɔn da no ba ntɛm yi? Ɛno mu na ɔsoro bɛsɔ ogya asɛeɛ, na wiem mfitiasedeɛ anane ahye. 13#Yes 65.17; 66.22; Adi 21.1; 21.27 Na sɛdeɛ ne bɔhyɛ teɛ no, yɛretwɛn ɔsoro foforɔ ne asase foforɔ a tenenee te mu no.
Afotuo a ɛdi akyire ne awieeɛ
14 # 1 Ko 1.7-8 Enti, adɔfo, ɛnam sɛ moretwɛn yeinom nti, mommɔ mmɔden na wɔahu mo sɛ nnipa a wɔnni nkekaeɛ ne dɛm asomdwoeɛ mu, 15#Rom 2.4 na mommu yɛn Awurade abodwokyɛre no sɛ nkwagyeɛ, sɛdeɛ yɛn nua dɔfo Paulo nso de ne nyansa a wɔde ama no twerɛɛ mo no, 16sɛdeɛ ɔyɛeɛ wɔ ne nwoma nyinaa a ɔka yeinom ho nsɛm wɔ mu no mu nso. Emu na nsɛm a ne nteaseɛ yɛ den, na wɔn a wɔnsuaa adeɛ na wɔn ase ntimiiɛ toto no, sɛdeɛ wɔyɛ atwerɛ nsɛm a aka no nso, ma wɔn ara wɔn sɛeɛ no.
17 # Mar 13.5; 13.9; 13.33 Enti, adɔfo, ɛnam sɛ monim dada nti, monhwɛ mo ho so yie, na wɔamfa amumuyɛfoɔ nnaadaasɛm no amfa mo ankɔ bi, na moamfiri mo ara mo tim a moatim no mu anhwe ase. 18Na monnyini yɛn Awurade ne Agyenkwa Yesu Kristo adom ne nimdeɛ mu. Ɔno na animuonyam nka no seesei ne daa. Amen.#3.18 Tete atwerɛ foforɔ a wɔgye tomu binom nni Amen

pageProps.chapterText:
Adɔfo, yei ne nwoma a ɛtɔ so mmienu a meretwerɛ mabrɛ mo. Emu na mede nkaeɛ mekanyane mo adwene gyenegyene, sɛ monkae nsɛm a adiyifoɔ kronkron no aka ato hɔ, ne yɛn a yɛyɛ mo asomafoɔ ahyɛdeɛ a ɛyɛ yɛn Awurade ne Agyenkwa deɛ no.
Monhunu yei kane sɛ, nna a ɛdi akyire no mu, fɛdifoɔ a wɔdi wɔn ara wɔn akɔnnɔ akyire de fɛdie bɛba abɛka sɛ: Ne ba ho bɔhyɛ no wɔ he? Na ɛfirii sɛ agyanom dedaeɛ yi, ade nyinaa te sɛdeɛ ɛte firi adebɔ mfitiaseɛ. Na wɔhyɛ da ara ma wɔn werɛ firi sɛ, ɛfiri teteete na ɔsoro wɔ hɔ, ne asase a ɛfiri nsuo mu, na ɛfiri nsuo mfimfini na ɛbɛtimm hɔ wɔ Onyankopɔn asɛm so. Wɔn so ara na ɛnam na nsuo yiri sɛee wiase a na ɛwɔ hɔ wɔn berɛ so no. Na ɔsoro ne asase a ɛwɔ hɔ yi, wɔde n’asɛm no ara na akora, na wɔde asie ama ogya, ama atemmuo ne nnipa amumuyɛfoɔ sɛeɛ da no.
Na, adɔfo, mommma adeɛ baako yi nnhunta mo, sɛ da koro yɛ Awurade sɛ mfirinhyia apem, na mfirinhyia apem yɛ no sɛ da koro. Awurade nkyɛre ne bɔhyɛ ho, sɛdeɛ ebinom bu no sɛ ɛkyɛreɛ, na mmom ɔma ne bo dwo kyɛre ma mo, ɔmpɛ sɛ obiara bɛyera, na mmom ɔpɛ sɛ wɔn nyinaa ba adwensakyera mu. Na Awurade da no bɛba sɛdeɛ owifoɔ ba. Emu na ɔsoro de kukurududu bɛtwam akorɔ, na ewie mu mfitiasedeɛ bɛhye asɛe, na asase ne mu nnwuma bɛhye.
Enti sɛ yeinom nyinaa bɛsɛe a, nnipa bɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ moyɛ wɔ abrabɔ kronkron ne nyamesom pa mu, sɛ motwɛn na morepɛ Nyankopɔn da no ba ntɛm yi? Ɛno mu na ɔsoro bɛsɔ ogya asɛeɛ, na wiem mfitiasedeɛ anane ahye. Na sɛdeɛ ne bɔhyɛ teɛ no, yɛretwɛn ɔsoro foforɔ ne asase foforɔ a tenenee te mu no.

Enti, adɔfo, ɛnam sɛ moretwɛn yeinom nti, mommɔ mmɔden na wɔahu mo sɛ nnipa a wɔnni nkekaeɛ ne dɛm asomdwoeɛ mu, na mommu yɛn Awurade abodwokyɛre no sɛ nkwagyeɛ, sɛdeɛ yɛn nua dɔfo Paulo nso de ne nyansa a wɔde ama no twerɛɛ mo no, sɛdeɛ ɔyɛeɛ wɔ ne nwoma nyinaa a ɔka yeinom ho nsɛm wɔ mu no mu nso. Emu na nsɛm a ne nteaseɛ yɛ den, na wɔn a wɔnsuaa adeɛ na wɔn ase ntimiiɛ toto no, sɛdeɛ wɔyɛ atwerɛ nsɛm a aka no nso, ma wɔn ara wɔn sɛeɛ no.
Enti, adɔfo, ɛnam sɛ monim dada nti, monhwɛ mo ho so yie, na wɔamfa amumuyɛfoɔ nnaadaasɛm no amfa mo ankɔ bi, na moamfiri mo ara mo tim a moatim no mu anhwe ase. Na monnyini yɛn Awurade ne Agyenkwa Yesu Kristo adom ne nimdeɛ mu. Ɔno na animuonyam nka no seesei ne daa. Amen.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
